text:
michelle: Quick one-pager for field — SLA + Security + deployment modes. Need: hero stat, 2-sentence pitch, 3 bullets for Hosted/Dedicated/Private, a short benchmark snapshot, a CTA, and lead-routing snippet. Live doc: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1A-example. Need a draft by EOD tomorrow. Thanks!

raj: Can we call out a conservative SLA target (99.9% uptime) and a high-level cost comparison: 20-30% lower per-token cost vs typical self-host for medium throughput? Also mention KV/prefix caching impact on p99 latency.

olivia: :thumbsup: Also add compliance badges (SOC 2 Type II, ISO27001, HIPAA) and a mention of KMS/HSM support + audit logs. For visuals, I'll prepare a small diagram for the three deployment modes.

ben: I'll draft the benchmark snapshot. Proposal (mock numbers, to be labeled "example workload"):
- Hosted API: p95 120ms, p99 240ms, approx $0.004 / 1k tokens
- Dedicated: p95 80ms, p99 150ms, approx $0.0025 / 1k tokens (for reserved capacity)
- Private / On-prem: highly variable; depends on infra — add a footnote.
I'll put these into the doc and mark as 'sample config'.

michelle: Prefer conservative phrasing: "typical observed" not guarantees. Add footnote: "Performance varies by sequence length, model family, and HW profile." Good.

olivia: Proposed inbound lead routing example (very small routing rules snippet for product folks / sales ops):
```
if lead.industry in ['finance','healthcare'] or lead.tags.contains('regulated'):
    route -> 'enterprise-ae' (notify: legal, security)
elif lead.size_estimate > 100k_tokens_month:
    route -> 'dedicated-sales'
else:
    route -> 'self-serve-nurture'
```

sales-jackson: Route suggestions: enterprise -> sales-evangelist; regulated -> AE-team + legal-alert; add tag 'deploy_mode_interest' with values [hosted, dedicated, private]. I'll update SFDC flow once we have final copy.

deploy-bot: DocsBot: Draft created — https://docs.google.com/document/d/1A-example (michelle @michelle please review). Attachment: none.

michelle: I'll review tonight. If green, plan to include this in the webinar promo: "Securing Inference at Scale" — 30 min talk + 15 Q&A, target Wed next week. Marketing to draft invites and benchmark snippets for slide deck.

raj: For messaging/testing, propose three headline variants to iterate on:
1) Security-first: "Enterprise-grade inference: private deployments & audit-ready controls"
2) Cost-first: "Lower per-token compute costs without sacrificing latency"
3) Reliability-first: "Predictable SLAs across hosted, dedicated and private"
We can A/B subject lines and hero stat.

olivia: :eyes: Quick callout — add a single-line differentiator: "Unified API and rollout controls across Hosted, Dedicated, and Private with built-in fallbacks and canary deploys." Keep it tight.

michelle: Assignments — Ben: benchmark numbers and table, Raj: messaging variants, Olivia: visuals and compliance badges, Jackson: routing rules/SFDC mapping, Michelle: assemble final one-pager and hand to field. Target: review complete by EOD tomorrow.

sales-jackson: :thumbsup: Ping me when ready; I'll wire the flows in Salesforce and add automation tags for inbound.

michelle: Thanks team — pushing this live asap. :rocket:
